- **离线 RAG 数据提取管道前段落地（`amos-pdf-parser`，2026-09-08）**：对应 `FUNCTIONAL_GAP_ANALYSIS` #7「无 RAG/本地检索」里用户把 PDF 丢给 AI 助手时「本地 7B 看不懂二进制 PDF」的第一步——把文字/表格榨成可喂进 context 的文本 + chunk。新成员 crate `crates/amos-pdf-parser`：**纯 Rust（`lopdf 0.34`，`default-features=false` + `nom_parser`，去 rayon/chrono 保 Android 交叉编译友好）**。核心：(1) `extract` 每页 **font-aware 提取文本**（走 lopdf `extract_text`，认 `Tf`/字体编码/ToUnicode，能扛真实/CJK 文档）；(2) `layout` 轻量文本矩阵追踪 → `table` 几何对齐表检测（`Model/Score` 式生成表），表可 `to_csv`/`to_markdown`；(3) `util::estimate_tokens` 脚本感知**近似 token**（CJK≈1/字符、Latin≈¼/字符，诚实标注是规划器不是 BPE）；(4) `chunk` RAG 分块（页锚 + overlap + 硬性 `est_tokens<=target`，CJK 永不在字符中间切）。软失败局部化：坏页给 warning + 空文本而非整篇失败。API：`PdfParser`/`ParsedPdf`/`ParsedPage`/`Table`/`chunk_document`；bin `amos-pdf-parser`（`--format text|json`、`--chunks`）。测试：**28 单测 + 6 集成（用 lopdf writer 生成真 2 页 PDF：正文页 + 3×2 表格页，走 FlateDecode 解码，验证 text/tables/chunk/路径/非法输入）全绿**；`clippy -D warnings`、`fmt --check` 干净；`cargo run --example make_sample_pdf` 端到端出样。诚实边界：表格几何通过 *lossy ASCII* 解码（CJK 单元格文字回读 page text）、`cm`/精确字宽未建模故列估算仅对「每格自建原点」的生成表可靠、纯扫描/图片 PDF 无文本层需 OCR（文档 `docs/offline-rag-pdf.md`）。

- **`amos-pdf-parser` 强化：font-aware 表格解码 + Android 交叉编译门禁（2026-09-08）**：表格单元格文本不再用 lossy ASCII 兜底——`layout` 解码改为**可插拔**（`rows_from_ops_decoded` 按 `Tf` 当前字体把字节交给解码器，默认 `ascii_text` 兜底），`extract::tables_for_page` 走 `get_page_fonts` + `get_font_encoding` + `Document::decode_text`（认字体编码与 `ToUnicode` cmap，能力与 `extract_text` 同级但保留每格几何）。**真实 CJK/非 ASCII 表格文字现在能保留**（只要字体带编码/ToUnicode）；集成测试在表格加一格 WinAnsi 字节 `0xE9`，断言回读成真 Unicode `é`（而非 `U+FFFD`）。单测 +2（解码传回真 Unicode、解码器收到当前字体名）→ **30 单测 + 6 集成全绿**，clippy `-D warnings`、fmt 干净。新增 **`make pdf-android-check` 门禁**（纯 Rust/lopdf 无 C，`cargo check --target aarch64-linux-android` 无需 NDK linker）+ host 测试，本机实测 EXIT 0。文档 `docs/offline-rag-pdf.md` 诚实边界与验证节同步更新。

- **`amos-pdf-parser` 航空航天级加固：无 unsafe / 无静默数据丢失 / 确定性 / 对抗健壮性（2026-09-08）**：审计修缺。(1) `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`（lib + bin），并保留生产期 `deny(unwrap/expect/panic)`——解析可报错/告警但**不崩溃**。(2) **消除静默降级**：字体/编码不可解析或解码失败而退回 lossy ASCII 的每个文本元素都被**计数并写入 `ParsedPdf.warnings`**（"N text element(s) decoded with ASCII fallback … may be lossy"）；忽略 warning＝主动接受有损，绝无隐性数据损坏；新增集成测试 `lossy_decode_is_surfaced_not_silent`（无 `Tf` 的 CJK show 必须浮出 warning）。(3) 确定性/幂等：表格检测与分块两次运行逐字节一致、chunk index 连续（新单测）。(4) 对抗健壮性：未知/畸形操作符、缺操作数、极端数值、错误操作数类型均不 panic（新单测 `pathological_operators_do_not_panic_and_are_deterministic`）。(5) 补边界单测：零页文档良构。门禁：**42 测试（35 单测 + 7 集成）全绿**、clippy `-D warnings`、fmt、`aarch64-linux-android` 交叉 check（A=0）。文档 `docs/offline-rag-pdf.md` 新增「Integrity, safety & determinism (aerospace-grade baseline)」一节。

### Fixed
- **计算器：按运算符后主显示显示该运算符而非暂存 `0`（2026-09-09）**：审计定位——reducer 按运算符后 `cur` 暂存为 `0` 是“等下一操作数”的正确内部态，但 UI 主显示区直接取 `st.cur`，于是按 `+` 后大屏出现 `0`（`calcDisplay` 本就隐藏该暂存 0）。给 `CalcState` 加 `justOp` 标志：按运算符置 true、键入操作数/`.`/`%`/`=`/清空置 false；新增纯 `calcPendingOperator(st)` 返回“等待第二操作数的运算符字形”；`CalculatorApp` 主显示在 `justOp` 时显示运算符（如 `+`）而非 `0`，键入第二操作数即切换为数字、`=` 出结果。**第二操作数真为 0**（如 `2+0=`）仍正确显示 `0`。测试：纯 `calculator.test.ts` 扩至 **26 例**（新增：按 `+` 后 `calcPendingOperator`==`+`、`cur` 仍暂存 `0`；输入 `3` 后清除并 `=5`）；Svelte DOM `calculator.test.ts` 扩至 **11 例**（新增：`2`→`+` 显示 `+`、`3` 显示 `3`、`=` 显示 `5`）。验证：纯 26、DOM 11、`tsc`/`svelte-check` 干净。


- **蓝牙页移除 Wi‑Fi 残留「当前网络」行（2026-09-08）**：审计蓝牙新代码发现第一个共用分组在蓝牙页也渲染「当前网络/开」行（该标签属 Wi‑Fi 语义）。改为该行仅 `which==="wifi"` 渲染；蓝牙页只显示主开关 + 下方本机配置。补断言：蓝牙页不含「当前网络」。settings.svelte **14/14**；全量 pure OK、vitest **54 文件 / 301 例全绿**、tsc/svelte-check 0/0。
- **App 宿主滚动：真机可翻看设置/长列表下方内容（2026-09-08）**：审计发现 Shell 的 App 宿主 `<div class="min-h-0 flex-1">` **无滚动容器**且外层 `overflow-hidden`——凡「内容流」类 App（设置/电话/相册/时钟…）超出视口即被裁切，真机上页面滑不动、看不到下方内容。修：宿主加 `overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain`（统一 ScrollView，惠及所有内容流 App）；`SettingsApp.nav` 导航时把滚动容器 `scrollTop=0` 重置到顶（回退 window 滚动，含 SSR 守卫）。补 shell 用例：App 面下存在 `.overflow-y-auto` 且为 `min-h-0` 的有界滚动区。shell **19/19**；全量 vitest **54 文件 / 297 例全绿**（+1）、tsc/svelte-check 0/0。
- **相机手势精化：快速双击不再误触发点按对焦（2026-09-08）**：审计 Phase-2 新代码发现——快速连击（<300ms）会同时触发「点按对焦/AE-AF 锁定」与 `ondblclick` 缩放，与 iOS（双击=缩放、对焦=两次慢点击）不符。修：单指 tap 经 `lastTapMs` 判定——距上次 tap <300ms 视为双击，抑制对焦、交给双击缩放；慢点击（300–500ms）正常聚焦/二次锁定。camera.svelte **11/11**（+双击抑制不锁用例，锁用例加 350ms 间隔）；全量 pure OK、vitest **54 文件 / 296 例全绿**（+1）、tsc/svelte-check 0/0。
- **相册查看器过滤语境修复（2026-09-08）**：审计最新代码发现——查看器翻页/键盘箭头/幻灯片用 `neighborOf(list,…)`（全量 list），♥ 收藏过滤激活时浏览会**跳到非收藏照片**，破坏过滤器语境。改为基于当前集合 `shown`（含查看器计数 `idx` 同步用 `shown`）。非过滤时 `shown===list`，行为不变（无回归）。补 Svelte 用例：预置 1 收藏+1 非收藏，进 ♥ 视图打开收藏断言 prev/next 禁用。photos.svelte **8/8**；全量 vitest **54 文件 / 294 例全绿**（+1）、tsc/svelte-check clean。

### Fixed
- **计算器 `%` 键语义修复（2026-09-08）**：审计+实证定位 `calcPress` 的 `%` 实现错误——原逻辑总是把当前输入 `/100`，在**挂起运算**上下文给出错误结果（如 `50 + 10 % =` 应为 `55` 实为 `5.1`；`50 × 10 % =` 应为 `250` 实为 `5`；`100 ÷ 4 % =` 应为 `25` 实为 `2500`）。修复为 iOS 语义：有挂起二元运算时，把右操作数变成**左操作数的百分比**（`left × cur / 100`，经 `normalize`+`evalExpr` 解析负/小数），无挂起（独立或 `=` 后）仍为 `/100`。`±` 实证正常未改。测试：纯层拆分为 2 例（独立 `/100` 含 `=` 后；iOS 挂起四则：`+`→55、`×`→250、`÷`→25、`−`→180），Svelte DOM 补 1 例（`50 + 10 % =`→55）。验证：纯 25、Svelte calculator 10/10、全量 vitest **54 文件 / 290 例全绿**（+1）、tsc clean。

- **媒体/外部存储领域内核 `crates/amos-media`（Phase A，2026-09-08）**：对接标准安卓文件目录的落地第一步（design `docs/android-storage-unify.md` §6-A）。建成与 `amos-sensor`/`amos-radio` 同构的纯 std 领域内核：`spec` 定义安卓标准集合 `StandardDir`（`DCIM/Camera`/`Screenshots`/`Pictures`/`Download`/`Recordings`/`Movies`/`Music`/`Root` + 各自 `canonical_path`）、`MediaKind`（Image/Video/Audio/File/Download）、`AccessKind`（Read/Write）与 `MediaItem`（**opaque `uri`**：真机 `content://` / mock `mock://`，不把字节 base64 进 store），均 serde 可过 Tauri 桥到 UI；`error` `MediaError` 类型化（`Unauthorized{access,collection}`/`NotFound`/`TooLarge`/`InvalidArguments`/`Provider`）；`provider` `MediaProvider` seam（哑读寄存器）+ 确定性 `MockMediaProvider`（`empty`/`from_items`/`seeded`/`single_photo`，`mock-<seq>` 确定性 id、单调 ts）+ `MAX_SAVE_BYTES`(64 MiB) 写上限；`manager` `MediaManager`+`Grant` 权限策略——**默认全无授权**，逐 `(access,collection)` 授权（真机对应 READ_MEDIA_*/MediaStore insert 模型），`list`=读门控、`save`=写门控，未授权返回诚实 `Unauthorized`（**绝不伪装空列表**）、空名单校验先于权限、`grant` 幂等可撤销；Provider 错误（如超上限）在授权后原样透传。已注册进 workspace member + workspace dep。测试：`tests/media_core.rs` 17 例 + error 单元 1 例 = **18 例绿**（spec 路径/serde、Mock 确定性/过滤/空集合/save 校验与上限、manager 默认无授权/读写分离/逐集合授权/幂等撤销/参数先于权限/Provider 错误透传）。验证：`cargo fmt --check` ✓、`clippy -p amos-media --all-targets -- -D warnings` ✓。工程纪律：`deny(clippy::unwrap_used/expect_used/panic)`（生产）、锁毒化用 `into_inner` 不 panic。诚实边界：Android MediaStore 真后端（Kotlin glue + 权限，Phase C）、Tauri `media_*` 命令层（Phase B）、HostFs(root/Waydroid) 与 Svelte 前端对接（Phase D/E）**本轮均未实现**——crate 仅提供 seam，真机行为需按 `docs/android-storage-unify.md` §6-C 至设备验收。

- **System UI 真机启动崩溃修复：相机被策略禁用不再崩 boot（`amos-tauri` Kotlin glue，2026-09-06）**：真机 AmOS 一启动即崩（白屏/进程被标 bad、WebView 白）。定位：`MainActivity.onStart → AmosGlue.onStart → CameraGlue.attach → openCamera` 在 **相机被设备策略禁用**（`ServiceSpecificException: Camera "0" disabled by policy`）时同步抛异常，而 attach 只 catch `SecurityException` → onStart 崩溃。修：(a) `CameraGlue.attach` 的 `openCamera` 改 catch `Exception` 并 `detach()` 释放半建资源、`Log.w`（相机禁用/占用/无授权均不再崩 OS UI）；(b) `AmosGlue.onStart` 用 `startQuietly` 逐个隔离 sensor/camera/flashlight 硬件 producer，任一不可用只告警不抛。`gen/android`（编译源）与 `android-glue/`（模板源）两处同步。另排障并记录：正确真机构建命令必须带 `--features android --target aarch64`（漏 feature → `TelephonyGlue.nativeAttach` 符号缺失崩溃；带 feature 单编 arm64 避开 armv7 `-laaudio` 链接失败）。验证：arm64 debug 装到 S5 后启动稳定、相机优雅跳过（`camera attach skipped: CAMERA_DISABLED`）；解锁后主屏/dock 经设备 WebView CDP 读 DOM 确认完整渲染（📞电话/💬信息/AI助手/🌐同传/✉️邮件在 dock）。
- **设备诊断日志 `lib/debugLog.ts` + dock 渲染埋点（frontend-ts，2026-09-06）**：为「真机某界面不渲染」类无法在浏览器复现的问题，新增命名空间日志 `amosLog/amosWarn`（前缀 `[amos][area]`，走 WebView console → adb logcat；`localStorage amos.debug.log=0` 可关）。埋点：`Shell` 每次可见表面变化打 `[amos][shell] surface=lock|app:<id>|edit|home`（主屏 dock 只在非锁/非 app/非编辑态渲染，此项直接判定是否卡在某表面）；`HomeDock` 挂载打 `[amos][dock] mounted {page,dock,…}`，dock 图标列表为空时打 `[amos][dock] …empty…` 并列出被过滤的持久化 id（持久化布局与 APPS 不匹配的常见根因）。验证：tsc clean；vitest svelte **74/74**；bun `[bun-iso] OK`；`vite build` ✓。诚实边界：根因仍待真机 logcat 读数（用户需重打包后回传 `[amos]` 行）。
- **来电振铃音 + 来电通话记录（frontend-ts，2026-09-06）**：真机 daemon 来电路径补两处闭环。(a) **来电振铃**：`components/IncomingCall.tsx` 在来电（`phase==="ringing"`）期间用 WebView `AudioContext` 循环播放 620Hz 振铃（0.5s 响 / 1s 间隔），接听/拒接/挂断即停——补上前一版只做了去电 Dialing 回铃、来电无声的空档。(b) **来电通话记录**：此前仅去电写 `amos.calllog`（PhoneApp/useOutgoingCalls），来电从不落库，导致 Phone「最近/常用」看不到来电。现 `IncomingCall` 用 `surfacedId` ref 追踪「已上屏的来电」，在其 `Ended`（接听/未接/拒接）时经 `readStoreValue`→`recordCall`→`writeStoreValue(CALLLOG_KEY,…)` 写入共享通话记录，`surfacedId` 去重保证每次来电只记一条、重复事件不重复写；React `writeStoreValue` 与 Svelte `createStoreValue` 共用事件桥，PhoneApp「最近/常用」即时刷新。验证：`tsc --noEmit` exit 0；vitest svelte 套件 **74/74**；`vite build` ✓。诚实边界：音频走 WebView（真机若因自动播放/音频焦点无声，需改原生 RingtoneManager/`resume()`，见对话记录）。
- **显示保护 / 自动息屏（auto screen-off，idle → 锁屏 → 省电闭环，2026-09-05）**：真机 OS 需要的不是桌面“屏保动画”，而是“无操作 N 秒后自动熄屏”并让电源策略听到 `screen_on=false`。
  **新 crate `amos-display`（纯 std）**——`ScreenState{On,Off}`/`ScreenChange`；`IdlePolicy`（电池 vs 充电分档超时）+ `ScreenController` 确定性状态机（`touch/probe/sleep/wake`，probe 尊重 hold 与 `hold_screen`，亚秒超时下限 1s 防“首拍即熄”）；**reason-keyed sticky hold**（`set_hold("call"/"nav")/clear_hold/held/holds`，重叠来源各自清除）；`host` 提供 **`AMOS_SCREEN_STATE_PATH` 文件契约**（`on|off`，容忍 `1/0/true/…`，垃圾按 unknown 不猜）。

- **LMK/bridge 审计与补全（2026-09-05）**：对 LMK-proxy 与双向桥做一致性审计并补全两处。 (1) **反向 RPC 的 host 回填缺口**：`AndroidManagerService::apply_host_action`（被 `ApplyHostDecision` RPC 调用）原只作用于容器、不回填 host——若宿主经 wire 主动 reclaim/freeze 而 host 未先动作会失步。现改为按 proxy **实际结果**回填：`Reclaim`→`report_host_killed`、`Freeze`/`Thaw`→`report_host_state(实际态)`（受保护任务被拒冻时如实上报非 Cached，避免把前台 app 误标墓碑）。+2 服务测试：RPC reclaim 上报 `kill`、freeze 保护层不上报 `cached`（后台才 `cached`）。(2) **`drive_host_decisions` 每次 per-id 克隆 managed 集合（O(n²)）**：改为进入循环前快照一次。验证：`amos-android` **51 单测** + 1 真 UDS e2e；`clippy --all-targets -D warnings` / fmt 干净；正向桥、反向驱动、governor lib 全绿。`docs/lmk-proxy.md` 同步。
- **`ApplyHostDecision` RPC —— 反向桥的 wire 入口（`amos-android` + `android_compat.proto`, 2026-09-05）**: 让 System UI / 宿主也能经 gRPC 主动把 host 决定下发容器（镜像 `apply_host_action`），与 daemon beat 的 `drive_host_decisions` 并列。`proto/android_compat.proto` 增 `HostAction` 枚举（FREEZE/THAW/RECLAIM）+ `HostActionRequest` + `AndroidManager::ApplyHostDecision(HostActionRequest)→Empty`；`AndroidManagerService` 实现 `apply_host_decision` handler（映射枚举 + 调 `apply_host_action`），`UNSPECIFIED`→`InvalidArgument`。验证：`amos-android` **51 单测** + 1 真 UDS e2e（新增：relaunch → `ApplyHostDecision(Reclaim)` → snapshot 空 + 记录式 runner 断言第二条 `am force-stop`）；`clippy --all-targets -D warnings` 干净；fmt 干净；`amos-ai` 编译通过。文档：`docs/lmk-proxy.md` §5/§6/§8、`android-compat.md`、CHANGELOG。
- **container ↔ host 反向驱动（daemon 回收决定 → 容器 `am force-stop`，2026-09-05）**: 把桥补成**双向**。(a) `amos-android::lmk` 增 `HostAction{Freeze,Thaw,Reclaim}`；`AndroidManagerService` 增 `with_parts(manager,proxy,host)`（daemon 共享同一批实例）与 `apply_host_action`（反向落地到 proxy + manager force-stop）。(b) `amos-ai::governor_service::GovernorLmkHost` 记录「容器管理」包集合（首注册加入、kill/反向回收移除，`managed_ids()`）；新增 `drive_host_decisions(outcome, host, proxy, manager)`——只对容器管理 app 执行：`reclaimed`→真 `am force-stop`+proxy 移除、`frozen/thawed`→proxy 镜像 tier，host-native app 不误杀。(c) `amos-ai::server.rs::serve()` 用共享 proxy/manager/host 构建 android 服务（`with_parts`），并在 governor beat 每次 `observe` 后调用 `drive_host_decisions` 反向驱动。验证：`amos-android` **47 单测**（+`host_state`/`HostAction` key + `host_reclaim_drops_the_container_task`）+1 真 UDS e2e；`amos-ai` 新增集成 `tests/lmk_reverse_drive.rs`（共享 governor + 记录式 `WaydroidRuntime`：`observe(memory_pressure)` 同时回收容器 WeChat 与 host-native "notes"，反向只对 WeChat 下发 `am force-stop com.tencent.mm`、不误杀 notes，proxy 清空、managed 清空）；桥集成 + 反向集成 + governor lib 全绿；`clippy --all-targets -D warnings` 干净；fmt 干净。诚实剩余 seam：`amos-wm` `legacy` 表面拆除、no-UI `SurfaceControl` teardown、host thaw→容器 surface 唤醒（`docs/lmk-proxy.md` §8）。
- **container ↔ host LMK 桥（`MoveApp` 上送 daemon `ResourceGovernor`，2026-09-05）**: 打通两套 registry。(a) `amos-android::lmk` 增纯映射 `host_state`（host 无可设 `Visible`，容器 `Visible`→host `Foreground` 以保受保护）与 `LmkHost` sink trait + 默认 `NoopLmkHost`。(b) `AndroidManagerService` 增 `with_manager_and_host`/`with_runtime_and_host` + `server_with_host`，并在每处容器转移上报：`launch`→`report_state(Foreground)`、`OnActivity`→`report_state(host_state(tier))`（Destroy→Stopped）、`TriggerLmk` 的 `Freeze`→`report_state(Cached)`、`Kill`→`am force-stop`+`report_killed()`。(c) `amos-ai::governor_service::GovernorLmkHost` 实现 `LmkHost`，绑定**同一个** `Arc<Mutex<ResourceGovernor>>`（现状同则跳过防 LRU 失真；未注册先 `register_app` 再 `move_app`；`kill_app` 移除）。(d) `amos-ai::server.rs::serve()` 用 `server_with_host(runtime, GovernorLmkHost)` 替换原 `server(runtime)`，android 服务与 `Governor` 服务、周期 beat 共享同一 governor。验证：`amos-android` **46 单测**（新增 `host_state` 映射 + 2 项假 `RecordingHost` 上报测试：launch/background/kill、`Pause`→host `foreground` 且永不见 `visible`）+ 1 真 UDS e2e；`amos-ai` 新增**集成测试 `tests/lmk_governor_bridge.rs`**（同一共享 governor 下，launch→host `register→Foreground`、OnActivity Stop→`MoveApp→Background`、TriggerLmk Critical→`kill→移除`，经 `Governor::GetState` 读回一致）；`clippy --all-targets -D warnings` 干净；fmt 干净。诚实方向：这是**容器→daemon 单向 advisory 上送**；反向（host `observe` 决定驱动容器物理 kill / 解冻唤醒 surface）仍留后续（`docs/lmk-proxy.md` §8）。
- **LMK-proxy `Kill` 真正执行到容器 (`amos-android`, 2026-09-05)**: 把上一步留作 seam 的「物理 kill」落地为可离线验证的容器下发。(a) `AndroidController::force_stop` → `waydroid shell am force-stop <pkg>`（`CommandRunner` 注入、可测）。(b) `AndroidRuntime` trait 增默认 `force_stop`（不可杀则 `Err`）；`WaydroidRuntime` 委托 controller、`DemoRuntime` 记录 `stops()`（+访问器）。(c) `EnhancedAndroidManager::force_stop_app`（镜像 `launch_app` 的超时保护）。(d) `service::trigger_lmk` 对每个 `Kill` victim 经 manager 真下发 `am force-stop`（先放锁再 await，best-effort：失败仅日志、不中断整轮）。验证：controller +2、runtime +1、既有 = **43 单测**；真 UDS e2e 用**记录式 `FakeRunner`** 同链断言「launch → `waydroid app launch`、Kill → `waydroid shell am force-stop com.tencent.mm`」；`clippy --all-targets -D warnings` 干净；fmt 干净；`amos-ai` 编译通过。诚实边界：容器侧 Kill 已接线；仍待真机的是 `amos-wm` `legacy` 表面拆除与 no-UI 基座 `SurfaceControl` teardown（`docs/lmk-proxy.md` §7）。
- **Android LMK-proxy / Activity-Task 生命周期代理 (`amos-android/src/lmk.rs`, 2026-09-05)**: 把「容器内 legacy APK 的生死」收到 AmOS 控制下，代理 Waydroid/容器的静默 `lmkd`。(a) **Activity/Task 状态机 + LMK-proxy 纯逻辑**：每启动包一条 `Record`（`window_id`/top-Activity 生命周期/前台服务标记/冻结 `Cached` 标记/LRU `seq`），派生重要性 tier 复用 `amos_applife::AppState`（rank/key 与 `governor.proto` 零漂移）；`launch/resume/pause/stop/destroy/start_service/stop_service/freeze/thaw`。(b) **内存压力裁决**：`plan`（只读不改）/`apply`（决定并就地转移）→ `MemoryPressure{None,Low,Critical}`：Low 冻结 LRU `Background→Cached`（不杀），Critical 回收（杀）LRU `Cached→Background`；保护层（Foreground/Visible/ForegroundService）永不被选；victim 带 `window_id` + `action`。物理 kill/表面 teardown 留作调用侧 seam（`am force-stop` + `amos-wm` teardown，需真机）。(c) **gRPC 接线（additive）**：`proto/android_compat.proto` 新增 `OnActivity`/`GetLmkSnapshot`/`TriggerLmk` + `ActivityEvent`/`MemoryPressure` 枚举；`AndroidManagerService` 持 `Arc<Mutex<LmkProxy>>`，`launch_android_app` 成功即收养该包为前台任务。验证：lmk 12 + service 5 + 既有 24 = **41 单测**全绿，真 UDS e2e 一轮 `launch→OnActivity(Stop)→GetLmkSnapshot→TriggerLmk(Critical)`（victim `window_id`/`killed=true` 就位）；`clippy --all-targets -D warnings` 干净；fmt 干净；`amos-ai` 编译通过。设计/诚实边界：`docs/lmk-proxy.md`。

- **Audit of the new WM geometry domain (`amos-wm/src/{layout,split}.rs`, 2026-09-04)**: found and fixed a divider-honesty gap in `SplitScreen::set_screen`. It validated a new screen only via the lenient `split_panes` (which silently clamps the divider to the min-feasible band), so after `resize_to` a *narrower/rotated* screen could be accepted with `percent()` no longer matching the real geometry. Now `set_screen` also requires the current percent to be feasible on the new screen (`percent_feasible`), rejecting it otherwise and keeping the old screen — matching `resize_to`'s never-silently-clamp rule. +1 regression test (`set_screen_never_silently_clamps_the_divider`). amos-wm lib **28 passed**; `clippy -D warnings` clean; fmt clean.

Also `WindowManager::split_candidates()` returns the front two shown non-Launcher windows to seed a split. +7 tests. amos-wm lib **27 passed**; `clippy -D warnings` clean; fmt clean.
- **Desktop geometry / split-screen domain (`amos-wm/src/layout.rs`, 2026-09-04)**: adds the pure-`std` decision layer behind the roadmap's free-resize + split-screen features. `Bounds`/`Size` with `enforce_min` (a resize never shrinks below minimum) and `clamp_into` (a dragged/resized window stays on-screen); `split_panes(screen, axis, gap, percent, min)` returns two disjoint, min-sized panes (Vertical left/right or Horizontal top/bottom) or `None` when the screen cannot host two minimum panes + gap (never a zero/negative pane). Transport-agnostic, matching the WM crate convention — the `amos-tauri` host maps `Bounds` onto the real backend. +6 unit tests. amos-wm lib **20 passed**; `clippy -D warnings` clean; fmt clean.
- **Multi-window WM audit (`amos-wm`, 2026-09-04)**: audited the transport-agnostic window state machine and fixed a state-consistency bug in focus fallback. (a) When the **focused** window was hidden/closed, focus fell back to the previous window but left it in `Shown` state — so `focused()` pointed at a window whose `state_of` was not `Focused` and **no** window was `Focused` (model/state disagreement). Now `promote_fallback_after` promotes the new top of the recents stack to `Focused` on hide/close. (b) Fixed a follow-on: closing a **non-focused (background)** window no longer leaves a stale dead id in the recents/`z_order` (close now always purges the stack entry). (c) Strengthened `assert_wm_invariants` to require `focused()` ⇔ exactly one window in the `Focused` state (both directions) so this class of bug is caught by the 2000-step property test. +3 regression tests (hide promotes fallback to Focused; close promotes Launcher when nothing left; closing a background window purges recents). amos-wm lib **14 passed** (incl. the strengthened property test); `clippy -D warnings` clean; fmt clean; `amos-tauri` consumer compiles.

Verified: `amos-ai` lib **118 passed** (was 109; +7 privacy +2 security); `clippy -D warnings` clean; fmt clean.

- **Composed resource/energy/lifecycle/scheduler closed loop `amos_ai::governor` (2026-09-04)**: new daemon-side `ResourceGovernor` that ticks `amos-power` (energy decision) → `amos-scheduler` (fire exact alarms, run deferred jobs only when power allows, doze-proxy = `throttle_background`) → `amos-applife` (on `PowerSave` freeze idle `Background` apps to `Cached` tombstone; on recovery + screen-on thaw them; under explicit memory pressure reclaim the LRU cached/background victims). Deterministic `observe(now, telemetry, memory_pressure, maintenance_open) -> GovernorOutcome`; public registration delegates (`register_app`/`background_app`/`schedule`) let a per-app host seed apps/jobs. - **Background-task scheduler + wakeup-alignment core `amos-scheduler` (2026-09-04)**: closes audit gaps §3.P2 #10/#12 ("无后台任务调度器" / 唤醒对齐) with a pure-`std` register of `AlarmExact` vs `Deferred` jobs. `spec` — `JobId`, `JobType` (+keys), `PowerState` with `deferred_runnable()` (charging → run; dozing → only in an open maintenance window; else run). `scheduler::Scheduler` — `register`/`cancel`/`complete`, `due(now, power)` returns exact alarms first then **coalesces all due deferred jobs into one batch** (fewer wakes), `next_wake(now)` gives the next guaranteed exact-alarm tick for a real `AlarmManager`, `counts()`, `kind(id)`. `ScheduledJob::new` + `register` reject inverted windows. Deterministic (caller supplies `now` in ticks + `PowerState`). Design: `docs/scheduler.md`. Tests: 7 lib + 1 integration (`tests/doze_cycle.rs`: alarm fires during Doze at its tick with `next_wake=300`; deferred withheld while idle, coalesced in the next maintenance window); `clippy --all-targets -D warnings` + fmt clean. Real `AlarmManager`/`JobScheduler`/Doze-feed binding + `amos-applife` tombstone-linkage remain caller seams.
- **Energy-governor domain core `amos-power` (2026-09-04)**: closes the audit gap "isolated energy-policy knobs but no closed-loop decision layer" (`docs/bottom-layer-os-audit.md` §3.P2 #11) with a pure-`std`, deterministic power-save decision kernel. Folds `BatteryState` (level/charging/temp) + live `power_mw` (via `amos-profiling::PowerSource`) + foreground/background `Usage` into a `SensorMode` recommendation through `policy::decide` — a **pure rule with entry/exit hysteresis** (low-battery on/off band + thermal exit cushion → no boundary flapping). Output `Decision { sensor_mode, cap_inference, throttle_background, reason }`; `Decision::apply_to(&SensorManager)` pushes the mode into `amos-sensor`'s real manager (reusing `SensorMode`, no duplicated enum). Stateful `EnergyGovernor::observe` carries the last decision for the periodic-ticker caller. `Policy::normalized()` guarantees `critical ≤ save_on ≤ save_off` + `critical_temp > high_temp` even on contradictory input. Priority: thermal-critical > battery-critical > battery-low > thermal-high > power-draw > charging(Performance) > healthy(Balanced); healthy throttles background inference only when the screen is off. Now covered by `gated-check` (`cargo test -p amos-tauri --test assistant_voice_e2e`). Tests: `assistant_voice_e2e` now **3** pass; lib + test clippy `-D warnings` clean; fmt clean.
- **Airplane-mode cascade is atomic (rollback, `amos-radio`, 2026-09-04)**: hardens `RadioManager::set(Airplane, true)` so enabling Airplane is no longer a partially-applied write. It now snapshots the prior state first, and if any cascade step (Airplane→on, then Wi-Fi→off, then Bluetooth→off) fails **after** Airplane is already on, it rolls every radio bit back to the prior snapshot before returning the provider error — no partial Airplane state can leak to the user/provider. Failure-injection tests: a `FlakyProvider` whose Wi-Fi/Bluetooth writes fail on demand proves Wi-Fi-cascade failure, Bluetooth-cascade failure, and the all-success path each leave the provider exactly as expected. Tests: `amos-radio` **13** pass (3 new); `clippy -D warnings` clean; fmt clean.
- **Resident-voice handle hardening (`amos-tauri`, 2026-09-04)**: audit-driven completion of the newest capture code. `spawn_resident_capture` now **refuses sub-16 kHz mic rates loudly** (it only down-samples; 8 kHz previously spawned a worker that silently never streamed). `ResidentVoiceHandle` gains **non-blocking `request_stop(&self)`**, and `stop()` now delegates to it before joining — so callers can avoid blocking a live (e.g. AAudio) mic read when they must not wait. Tests: `assistant_voice` module **12** pass (2 new: sub-16k rejection, request_stop→stop lifecycle); `amos-tauri --lib` clippy `-D warnings` clean; fmt clean.
- **Inbound audio frame bound (memory-DoS guard, `amos-ai`, 2026-09-04)**: the daemon's voice path feeds untrusted `Payload::Audio` bytes straight into `decode_f32_le` (allocating by client length). `ChatAsr::feed_audio` now caps a frame at `MAX_FRAME_SAMPLES` (160k ≈ 10 s @16 kHz) and **drops oversized frames before decode** (warn + `None`), so a malformed/malicious client can't make us allocate an unbounded buffer. Tests: `amos-ai` lib **75** pass (1 new: oversized frame dropped, recognizer still usable after); chat_asr 6; clippy `-D warnings` clean; fmt clean.
- **Assistant-voice double-start hygiene (`amos-tauri`, 2026-09-04)**: `assistant_voice_start` now **tears down any previous active voice session first** (`voice.stop()`), so a second start (e.g. a busy mic button) can't orphan the prior reader task or run two listeners emitting events to the same UI. Tests: `assistant_voice` module **12** pass; `amos-tauri --lib` clippy `-D warnings` clean; fmt clean.
- **Web-bundle installer path-traversal hardening (`amos-appstore`, 2026-09-04)**: closes a real security gap found in audit. `WebInstaller` already relied on the `tar` crate's `..`-rejection, but that only guards *archive entries* — the bundle's entry **`start`** is a path parsed from `amos-app.json` *after* unpack, and `read_file` accepted arbitrary `rel`, so `dir.join("../..")` could probe/read outside the install dir. Added `safe_relative`/`safe_join`: `validate_bundle` and `read_file` now refuse any non-relative/`..`/`.`/absolute/NUL path (clear `unsafe relative path …` error). (The manifest `id` was already confined to a safe slug by `AppManifest::validate`/`valid_id` — audit confirmed it, not a defect.) Tests: `amos-appstore` **36** pass (2 new: traversal `start` refused + decoy untouched; `read_file` refuses `..`/absolute/NUL while subdir reads still work); clippy `-D warnings` clean; fmt clean.


- **Call recording — full-stack capability (`amos-telephony` + `proto` + `amos-tauri` + `frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: 通话录音 as a first-class, contractual feature across every layer. Domain kernel (`session.rs`) gains a `RecordingState { Off, On, Failed }` on `Call` with whitelisted transitions — recording is legal only while a call is **Active** and **non-emergency** (emergency/110-112 lines are a hard refusal), auto-reset to `Off` on hang-up, and a device `Failed` state is surfaceable + retryable. `TelephonyProvider` seam adds `start_recording`/`stop_recording` (provider decides allow/deny via a consent/jurisdiction policy knob; domain denies before the provider is consulted). `proto/telephony.proto` adds a `RecordingState` enum, `CallSnapshot.recording`, and `StartRecording`/`StopRecording` RPCs returning the authoritative snapshot; `CallSnapshot` records carry `recording`. gRPC `TelephonyService` maps it all; Tauri bridge exposes `telephony_start_recording`/`telephony_stop_recording` (+ `TelephonyCallPayload.recording`). `PhoneApp` in-call screen offers a record toggle (start/stop, live "正在录音" indicator) that mirrors the daemon's authoritative state and never claims a recording the OS declined. i18n en/zh (`phone.record*`). Tests: 41 unit (recording domain/provider/service: legality, emergency-forbid, policy denial, failure→retry, end-resets, status-carries-recording, RPC error mapping) + 3 `PhoneRecording.test.tsx` DOM tests. Real audio capture stays with the future audio pipeline; this delivers the state machine + contract + UI control.

- **Messages unread → dock badge (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: `MessagesApp` now publishes unread incoming messages as app notifications (`app` = “信息”, 💬, capped at 20), so the home dock “信息” badge and notification center reflect short-message unread (cleared as messages are read/cleared, no spurious writes when all read). DOM tests (`MessagesApp.test.tsx`).

- **Messages / 短信息 hardening (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: audit + completion of `lib/messages.ts` — `appendMessage`/`appendQuote` now trim text and refuse blank bodies; `normalizeMessages` caps history at `MESSAGE_CAP` (200) so a conversation can't grow unbounded; added `MESSAGE_CAP` const; `MessagesApp` writes every save through the normalizer, so the cap + self-heal apply live (not just on load). New dedicated `messages.test.ts` covers every export (seed/append/quote/normalize-cap/clear/remove/time&day helpers/unread/markRead/markAllRead/constants).

- **Shared outgoing-call hook (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: extracted `lib/useOutgoingCalls.ts`, now used by both `ContactsApp` and `PhoneApp` — it owns call-history state and derives the Frequent ⭐/Recent quick-dial lists (name-resolved from live contacts) and the `recordOutgoing` (write calllog + raise phone notification) side-effect, removing the duplicated logic the two apps previously each inlined. Dedicated hook tests (`useOutgoingCalls.test.tsx`): name-resolved lists, and record→calllog+notification.

- **Phone dialer → call history & notification (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: `PhoneApp` now records successful dials into `amos.calllog` (feeding the shared Recent/Frequent strips) and raises a phone notification, matching `ContactsApp`; its keypad also shows "Frequent ⭐" and "Recent" quick chip rows (tap backfills the number, name resolved from contacts). DOM tests (`PhoneApp.test.tsx`).

- **Phone contacts / 通讯录 (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: a new `contacts` app (👥) with a production-grade `lib/contacts.ts` domain — pure, immutable, validation-normalizing ops (`normalizeContacts` repairs corrupt stores and dedupes ids, name + at-least-one-number required, cleaned/deduped phones), favorites, search by name or phone digits, name sorting (favorites first), durable under `amos.contacts`. New `ContactsApp` UI: search, add (with validation hint), favorite toggle, two-tap delete, and "call" out via the telephony bridge (graceful "daemon offline" when not bridged). Full unit tests (`contacts.test.ts` — 16) plus DOM interaction tests (`ContactsApp.test.tsx` — 4: list, call-offline, two-tap delete persists, add-validation). Registered in the app grid + i18n en/zh.
- **Contacts edit + duplicate guard + grouping (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: `ContactsApp` can now edit an existing contact (✏️ prefill → save via `editContact`); adding is refused when the number already exists (`contactsWithPhone`, digit-normalized incl. `+CC`/bare suffix match → "duplicate" hint); the list is grouped by letter (A–Z / `#`) with colored initial avatars (`contactLetter`/`groupContacts`/`avatarHue`). New pure helpers all unit-tested; contacts.ts stays at 100% function coverage.
- **Call history + recents (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: new `lib/calllog.ts` domain — pure, durable `amos.calllog`: `normalizeCallLog` (newest-first, keeps history for frequency stats, caps at 60, repairs corrupt stores), `recordCall`, `recentNumbers` (distinct quick-dial list), `frequentNumbers` ("常用"), `logNameFor`, `callDigits`. Successful bridged calls from `ContactsApp` are recorded (functional update, no stale-closure loss), and "Frequent ⭐" (top-by-frequency) and "Recent" quick-dial strips appear (number → contact-name lookup). Reverse lookup `contactNameFor` added to `lib/contacts.ts`. Unit tests (`calllog.test.ts`) + Contacts DOM tests (bridged-call → recents; repeated dial → frequent chip).
- **Radio / connectivity（`amos-radio` + `amos-tauri` + `frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04）**: new transport-agnostic domain crate `amos-radio` — `RadioMode`/`RadioSnapshot`, a `RadioProvider` seam + deterministic `MockRadioProvider`, and a `RadioManager` owning the policy (Airplane mode cascades Wi-Fi + Bluetooth off; the non-airplane radios are refused while Airplane is on; `set` returns the authoritative snapshot). 10 unit tests. The System UI drives it through in-process `radio_status`/`radio_set` Tauri commands (real Wi-Fi/Bluetooth on the no-UI Android base are Android system services reachable from the System UI APK, so unlike telephony these do not round-trip through the headless daemon), mirroring each snapshot back into the durable `amos.settings` store (cross-window broadcast). Notification-center wifi/bluetooth/airplane tiles go through the backend, with a same-policy `flipRadio` fallback outside Tauri and an authoritative `radioStatus` sync on open. A real Android backend is scaffolded as `AndroidRadioProvider` under the `android` feature (JNI `WifiManager`/`BluetoothAdapter`; `cargo check --features android` validates it compiles; on-device hookup pending). Design: `docs/radio.md`.
- **Status-bar radio indicators (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: the top `StatusBar` (home + every app shell) now shows Wi-Fi / Bluetooth / Airplane glyphs (airplane supersedes the others) derived from the shared quick-settings, updating **live** — same-window toggles via a new `STORE_CHANGED_EVENT` write signal, cross-tab via `storage`, and cross-window/bridged via the `store-updated` backend event. New reactive hook `lib/useStoreValue.ts` + pure `radioIcons` selector (unit-tested).
- **Location master switch (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: the Notification-Center `location` quick toggle is now a real system-level location-services switch. `locationEnabled`/`flipLocation` encode "default ON, explicit OFF disables", the tile reflects it, and `MapsApp` "Locate" refuses geolocation whenever it is OFF (even if the app already holds the `location` grant) with a localized hint; store-reactive via `useStoreValue`.
- **Do-Not-Disturb (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: the Notification-Center `dnd` quick toggle now really silences the OS — when ON (`dndActive`), every unread badge on the home screen / dock is hidden, and the notification-center list is shown muted (a 🌒 "DND" chip replaces the unread count). Home-dock notifications/quick-settings are read reactively via `useStoreValue`, so toggling DND anywhere updates the badges live. With this and Location, none of the quick toggles is purely cosmetic anymore.
- **Persistent DND indicator + ring/vibrate policy (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: the `StatusBar` now shows a persistent 🌒 moon while Do-Not-Disturb is active (and a 🔕 when the alert policy mutes alerts), always visible on home and inside every app. New `lib/sound.ts` models the notification sound policy bits — `ring`/`vibrate` under `amos.sound` (both default ON) with `normalizeSound`/`effectiveAlert` (DND mutes both) + a reactive `useAlertPolicy` hook. Unit-tested.
- **Notification-arrival haptic (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: a real consumer of the sound policy — when the home screen's unread set grows, HomeDock fires a short `navigator.vibrate` pulse, but only if the *effective* policy allows vibration (so DND or "vibrate off" silences it). Pure gate `shouldVibrateOnArrival` (unit-tested); mount-time existing badges never buzz.
- **Notification-arrival ring (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: completes the sound policy by also honouring the `ring` bit — the same arrival path now plays an asset-free two-note chime via the Web Audio API (`lib/notifyTone.ts`, synthesized `OscillatorNode` + gain envelope) only when the *effective* policy allows audible alerts (DND / "ring off" silences it). Pure gate `shouldRingOnArrival` (unit-tested); no-op in SSR/tests/headless.
- **Global arrival alert (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: the vibrate + ring arrival logic was hoisted out of `HomeDock` (which only renders on the home screen) into a reusable `useNotificationAlert` hook, mounted once in the `Shell` — so a new notification now pulses/rings on **every** screen (home, inside an app, even the lock screen), still gated by the effective sound policy and DND.
- **Notification banner (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: a transient toast now appears near the top whenever a notification arrives (newest one; auto-dismisses ~4 s), layered over every screen via a `NotificationBanner` mounted once in the phone frame. Do-Not-Disturb suppresses the banner (those notifications stay only in the Notification Center). **Tap to acknowledge** — clears that app's notifications (badge disappears) and dismisses the toast; works regardless of which screen is showing. Pure arrival selector `newestAddedNotif` (unit-tested) + DOM test for show/acknowledge.
- **Android radio provider wiring (`amos-tauri`, 2026-09-04)**: `amos-tauri` gained an `android` feature (`["dep:jni","amos-radio/android"]`) and a `RadioBridge::from_android(vm, env, context, airplane)` factory that backs the bridge with `AndroidRadioProvider` (real `WifiManager`/`BluetoothAdapter`) instead of the Mock. `scripts/build-android.sh` now also cross-compiles `amos-radio --features android`. Desktop default is unchanged (`mock_seeded`); `cargo check/clippy --features android` on the host validate the wiring compiles — on-device `run()` swaps in `from_android` with the Activity `JavaVM`/`Context` (docs/radio.md §6).
- **Bell unread badge (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: the home `TopBar` 🔔 now shows a live unread count (caps at 99+), hidden while Do-Not-Disturb is on — reactive via `useStoreValue`, matching the dock badges.
- **Test coverage completion (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: every exported function in the sound/notification/store modules now has a test — `useAlertPolicy` + `useNotificationAlert` (DOM hook tests: defaults, policy reflection, DND muting, DND silencing of the arrival vibrate), `playNotifyTone` (no-op without Web Audio; synthesizes a chime with a stubbed `AudioContext`), and an explicit `STORE_CHANGED_EVENT` dispatch assertion. `settings.ts` / `sound.ts` / `amosStore.ts` / `useStoreValue` / `notifyTone` pure functions are all covered.
- **Per-function coverage drive (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: brought `lib/permissions.ts` (83→100% funcs, durable ledger store round-trip), `lib/files.ts` (97.6→100%, `hasName`), `lib/notes.ts` (97.5→100%, `fmtTime`) and `lib/storeApps.ts` (50→100% funcs: tile cache `set/get/tileById`, `subscribe/notify`, and `loadStoreTiles` via a fake bridge) to full function/line coverage. Together with the already-at-100% pure modules (`bounded`, `maps`, `calculator`, `photos`, `weather`, `providers`, `systemButtons`) the pure-logic layer is now comprehensively covered (all 54 tests across the touched files pass).
- **Component-layer coverage (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: per-component `--coverage` sweep (pure presentational ones like `AppIcon`/`Segmented` already 100%). Raised `components/CapabilityGate.tsx` function coverage 71→86% by adding interaction tests for the `Deny`/refused branch, the `onAllowed` callback, and the "deny now → allow later" flow (children stay hidden until granted, nothing persisted on deny).
- **Session-feature component interaction tests (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: new DOM tests cover the radio/DND/notification UI branches — `StatusBar` (default wifi/bt glyphs, airplane supersedes with ✈️, DND shows persistent 🌒), `HomeDock` (unread badge appears for an app and is hidden under DND), and `NotificationCenter` (location master starts ON and toggling persists OFF; the dark tile drives the real theme). 6 tests across the three files, all passing.
- **Reactive-store cross-window correctness (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-04)**: `useStoreValue` now honours the authoritative `store-updated` payload from the Rust store instead of re-reading this window's (possibly stale) `localStorage`, and mirrors it back into `localStorage` for consistency. End-to-end tests simulate a second Tauri window pushing a `store-updated` event and assert the hook re-renders with the authoritative value and correctly resets on removal.
- **Network time calibration (`amos-timesync`, 2026-09-03)**: transport-agnostic `TimeSource` seam (`MockTimeSource` deterministic, `HostClock` offline fallback) feeding a `SyncedClock` that turns an authoritative network time into a signed host-clock offset, applies it to `now()`, rejects implausible times (plausibility window 2000–2100), and atomically persists the last-known-good offset (corrupt/missing file degrades gracefully). A `Timekeeper` runs the periodic sync loop. Real SNTP query is a `ntp` feature (`NtpTimeSource` via `sntpc` + `sntpc-net-std`, blocking work on `spawn_blocking`); a `ntp_probe` example does a live query. Deps: `async-trait`, `thiserror` (+ optional `sntpc`/`sntpc-net-std`).
- **Supervised periodic time sync (`amos-supervisor` `timesync` feature, 2026-09-03)**: optional background wall-clock calibration orchestrated alongside daemon supervision. Default build and behaviour unchanged; enabling the `timesync` feature and `AMOS_TIMESYNC=1` at runtime spawns a periodic `SyncedClock` loop (`AMOS_NTP_SERVER` for real SNTP, `AMOS_TIMESYNC_STATE`/`AMOS_TIMESYNC_INTERVAL_SECS` optional), exposes live calibrated-time status (`TimeSyncHandle::report()`: corrected now / offset / staleness, printed at startup, on SIGUSR1, and before shutdown), and exports the state path to supervised children via `AMOS_TIMESYNC_STATE` so any daemon can load the last-known-good calibrated clock. Added to `make gated-check`.
- **App store core engine (`amos-appstore`, 2026-09-03)**: transport-agnostic `AppManifest` catalog + `Version`, sha256 integrity check, and an `AppStore` engine driving download → verify → install / upgrade / uninstall over a pluggable `StoreProvider` (deterministic in-memory `MockStoreProvider` today) with a JSON-persisted installed registry. Publish contract + developer onboarding in `docs/appstore.md`.
- **App store CLI (`amos-appstore-cli`, 2026-09-03)**: headless terminal driver over the same engine (demo/catalog/search/install/upgrade/uninstall/status), mirroring `amos-mail-cli`; `--catalog <URL>` (with `--features live`) swaps the offline demo for the real HTTP backend.
- **App store HTTP backend (`amos-appstore` `live` feature, 2026-09-03)**: `HttpStoreProvider` fetches a remote `MockCatalog` JSON catalog + downloads packages over HTTP (ureq in `spawn_blocking`); feature-gated so the default build stays offline-green. Both the CLI (`--catalog`, `--features live`) and the Tauri `StoreBridge` (`AMOS_APPSTORE_CATALOG`, `--features appstore-live`) can select it at runtime via a type-erased `Box<dyn StoreProvider>`.
- **App store publisher signing (`amos-appstore`, 2026-09-03)**: Ed25519 signing/verification of app manifests (`DeveloperKey`/`sign_manifest`/`verify_manifest_signature`, `publisher` field); the engine verifies a signed manifest's signature before install/upgrade and refuses mismatches (`BadPublisherSignature`). Dep: `ed25519-dalek`.
- **Web-bundle installer (`amos-appstore`, 2026-09-03)**: `webinstall::WebInstaller` unpacks a verified `tar.gz` web-bundle (`index.html` + assets + `amos-app.json`) into `<root>/<id>/`, validates the entry file, writes `manifest.json`, and uninstalls; `tar` refuses `..`/absolute paths. Deps: `tar`, `flate2`.
- **Web-bundle server resolver (`amos-appstore`, 2026-09-03)**: `serve::{resolve_request, content_type_for}` maps a host request path safely onto a file inside an installed bundle (refuses traversal/`..`, falls back to `index.html`, returns MIME + `nosniff`) — the server-side gate a future custom-protocol host needs.
- **Engine web-bundle install (`amos-appstore`, 2026-09-03)**: `AppStore::with_web_install_dir(dir)` makes `install`/`upgrade` of a `tar.gz` bundle also unpack it to `<dir>/<id>/` (and `uninstall` removes it); a bundle that can't unpack fails the install and isn't recorded. Tests cover unpack→uninstall and broken-bundle rejection.
- **StoreBridge bundle serving (`amos-tauri`, 2026-09-03)**: `StoreBridge` reads `AMOS_APPSTORE_INSTALL_DIR` and configures the engine's web-install dir; new command `appstore_bundle_resource(id, path)` returns a bundle file as base64 + MIME (sanitised by `serve::resolve_request`), so a local web-bundle can be rendered without a custom protocol. Headless-tested.
- **App Store System-UI page (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-03)**: new "App Store" app (`components/StoreApp.tsx`, registered in `APPS`/`COMPONENTS`) browses the catalog (offline demo or HTTP) and install / update / uninstall through the `store*` bridge, with graceful offline fallback outside the Tauri shell. i18n zh/en.
- **Dynamic home registry for store apps (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-03)**: store-installed apps become persistent home-screen tiles (`lib/storeApps.ts`, `store:<mid>` ids merged into `amos.home.layout`); `HomeDock`/title/`AppComponent` resolve them and tapping opens a placeholder container (`components/ExtApp.tsx`) until a real runtime host (installer) lands. Store page changes notify the shell live.
- **Durable system state store (`amos-tauri` + `frontend-ts`, 2026-09-03)**: `SharedStore` persists every `amos.*` mutation to disk (`$AMOS_STATE_FILE`, default `~/.amos/state.json`); on boot the shell hydrates localStorage from it, so state recovers even after localStorage is cleared.
- **Permission ledger (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-03)**: `lib/permissions.ts` — pure, immutable, durable (store-backed `amos.permissions`) grants of sensitive capabilities (camera/microphone/location/notifications) per app; query/grant/revoke + normalize. UI dashboard + enforcement wiring next.
- **Privacy & permissions dashboard (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-03)**: new "privacy" app (`components/PermissionsApp.tsx`, in `APPS`) lists each capability with its granted apps (revocable) and allow/deny toggles for the built-in apps that request it; changes persist in the durable store.
- **Permission enforcement — camera (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-03)**: `CameraApp` now refuses to call `getUserMedia` until the "camera" capability is granted for the camera app; an allow/deny overlay prompts first, and denying blocks the feed (retry from the Privacy app). Mic/location call sites still to gate.
- **Reusable capability gate (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-03)**: `components/CapabilityGate.tsx` exports `useCapability(appId, cap)` + a `<CapabilityGate>` allow/deny overlay + `revokeCapability`; generic i18n (`perm.allow/deny/askAllow/denied`). Ready to apply to mic/location call sites.
- **Permission enforcement — location (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-03)**: `MapsApp` "Locate" now asks before calling geolocation: ungranted taps show an allow/deny banner, and geolocation only runs once the "location" capability is granted for maps (persisted). Microphone call sites (VoiceMicButton / BackendApps) remain to gate with the same hook.
- **Permission enforcement — microphone (`frontend-ts`, 2026-09-03)**: capture is gated behind the "microphone" capability for both the AI app's mic (`VoiceMicButton`, inline allow/deny bubble) and the interpreter's own capture (`BackendApps.InterpApp`, two-tap consent). None call `getUserMedia({audio})` before the capability is granted; allows persist (revoke via Privacy).
- **Time-sync CLI (`amos-timesync-cli`, 2026-09-03)**: headless driver over the same `SyncedClock` — `now`/`status` read the last-known-good calibrated clock from state (no network), `sync` runs one calibration pass (offline host clock by default; `--server`/`$AMOS_NTP_SERVER` does a real SNTP query behind the `ntp` feature), mirroring the other `*-cli` crates. Reads/writes the same `AMOS_TIMESYNC_STATE` file the supervisor exports, so operators and supervised daemons can consume the calibrated time. Added to `make gated-check`.
- **Daemon health & metrics (`amos-ai`, 2026-09-03)**: new `monitoring` module — `Monitor` keeps lock-free counters (RPCs seen at the gRPC boundary, uptime, periodic heartbeat ticks) and a `Monitor::spawn_periodic` self-health heartbeat that logs each snapshot (interval via `AMOS_METRICS_INTERVAL_SECS`, default 60s). RPCs are counted centrally by a tonic interceptor in `serve()`; `StatusReply` now carries `rpc_total`/`heartbeats`, so any `GetStatus` health probe reads the live metrics over the wire. Unit + real-UDS e2e coverage.

## [0.1.0] - 2025-09-01

### Added
- Initial release with core architecture
- AI daemon (amos-ai) with gRPC server over UDS
- Tauri 2 System UI (amos-tauri) as gRPC client
- Window manager state machine (amos-wm)
- Protocol buffer definitions (amos-proto)
- Waydroid/APK compatibility layer (amos-android)
- CI/CD workflow with GitHub Actions
- Comprehensive documentation

### Notes
- This is the initial beta release
- API and architecture subject to change before 1.0

## Template for new releases

When creating a new release:

1. Update version numbers in `Cargo.toml` across all crates
2. Update version in `tauri.conf.json`
3. Add corresponding section below with:
   - Date in YYYY-MM-DD format
   - Clear categorization of changes
   - Links to related issues/PRs
4. Update any affected documentation

### Commit message format:

```
chore(release): v0.X.Y

- Brief description of major features
- Link to release notes
```

### Release checklist:

- [ ] All tests passing (`make test`)
- [ ] All linting clean (`make lint`)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
- [ ] Version numbers updated
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed
- [ ] Security audit completed
- [ ] Tagged in git: `git tag v0.X.Y`
- [ ] GitHub release created with release notes
